summary.text: Lillian Ortiz-Self is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 21-Position 2 since January 22, 2014, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ortiz-Self was assigned to the Education Committee, the Human Services, Youth, & Early Learning Committee, the Innovation, Community & Economic Development, & Veterans Committee, the Labor and Workplace Standards Committee and the House Rules Committee during the 2023-2024 session, according to Ballotpedia.
